Creates a square sword space at\nthe nearest enemy's position and deals Physical Damage.
additionalBodyText: Increases sword space damage to <color=#FFCE1B>120%</color> Physical Attack Power.

bodyText: Spins a fan around itself.\nThe fan deals Physical Damage once per enemy each revolution.
additionalBodyText: Increases the fan's revolutions to <color=#FFCE1B>3</color>.

bodyText: Throws an axe toward the nearest enemy damaging enemies along its path.
additionalBodyText: The axe returns after reaching max range and can damage enemies again.

bodyText: Fires bullets in the four cardinal directions.
additionalBodyText: Fires <color=#FFCE1B>3</color> consecutive bullets in each direction.

bodyText: Creates sword spaces along the movement direction of the nearest enemy.
additionalBodyText: Increases sword spaces per target from <color=#FFCE1B>3</color> to <color=#FFCE1B>6</color>.

bodyText: Fires a single bullet at the nearest enemy.
additionalBodyText: Reduces attack cooldown by <color=#FFCE1B>30%</color> in total.

bodyText: Fires <color=#FFCE1B>3</color> bullets in a straight line toward the nearest enemy.\nGains <color=#FFCE1B>5</color> Physical Attack Power each level.
additionalBodyText: Increases bullets fired per attack from <color=#FFCE1B>3</color> to <color=#FFCE1B>8</color>.

bodyText: Fires <color=#FFCE1B>3</color> bullets in a <color=#FFCE1B>45</color> Degree spread toward the nearest enemy.
additionalBodyText: Expands the firing spread from <color=#FFCE1B>45</color> to <color=#FFCE1B>360</color> Degree.

bodyText: Fires a large, slow cannonball toward the nearest enemy,\npiercing enemies along its path.
additionalBodyText: Doubles the cannonball's travel speed.

bodyText: Fires a powerful piercing bullet toward the nearest enemy.
additionalBodyText: Reduces attack cooldown by <color=#FFCE1B>50%</color> in total.

bodyText: Rapidly fires low-damage machine-gun rounds at the nearest enemy.
additionalBodyText: Machine-gun rounds pierce enemies.

bodyText: Summons <color=#FFCE1B>3</color> magic circles around the nearest enemy.\nEach circle damages enemies within its area.
additionalBodyText: Increases the number of magic circles from <color=#FFCE1B>3</color> to <color=#FFCE1B>8</color>.

bodyText: Throws a fireball at the nearest enemy,\ndealing immediate Magic Damage and applying a non-stacking burn.\nReapplying the burn refreshes its duration.
additionalBodyText: Doubles the burn damage.

bodyText: Creates a large explosive magic circle near the nearest enemy.\nThe circle deals immediate Magic Damage and repeatedly damages enemies inside it.
additionalBodyText: Halves the damage tick interval, causing the magic circle to deal damage twice as often.

bodyText: Creates a gravity field near the nearest enemy.\nThe field periodically pulls nearby enemies toward its center but deals no damage.
additionalBodyText: Doubles the gravity field's duration.

bodyText: Fires a magic orb at the nearest enemy.\nThe orb has a <color=#FFCE1B>30/40/50%</color> chance to disable the target's abilities for a short duration.
additionalBodyText: Enemies hit by the magic orb are stunned.

bodyText: Periodically installs a magitech robot in an empty adjacent tile.\nRobots independently attack the nearest enemy.
additionalBodyText: The magitech robot's attacks slow enemies by <color=#FFCE1B>30%</color>.
